data.name: Co-Ed Casualty: A Chandler Chase Case
data.detailed_description:
Spring break was supposed to mean sunshine, parties, and a week away from Briarwood College. Journalism major Chandler Chase has his bags packed and is ready to leave for Florida with his roommate, Marcus, when a phone call from the Dean turns his plans upside down.

A student has been found dead on campus.

With most of Briarwood emptied for spring break and local police unable to find out what really happened, the Dean asks Chandler to investigate the incident before the situation explodes. Paired with criminal justice student (and rival) Elena Beaumont, Chandler is thrown into a mystery neither of them expected.

What first begins as a search for answers surrounding the death of fellow student Quinn Whittaker soon unravels into something that goes much deeper. As Chandler and Elena follow a trail of hidden clues and collegiate secrets, they uncover evidence of a conspiracy that stretches back to the university's founding. With every new discovery, one thing becomes increasingly clear:

Someone is onto them... and they'll do anything to keep them from discovering the truth.

Explore every corner of Briarwood College through detailed point-and-click environments inspired by classic mystery games. Spring break may have left the campus empty, but its halls are anything but vacant. Discover the nooks and crannies of a historic East Coast college, from residence halls and classrooms to towering library stacks and bustling student spaces. Every location is filled with interactive objects, memorable characters, hidden clues, and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Investigate a memorable cast of six fully voice-acted students, faculty, and staff as you piece together what really happened to Quinn. From Chandler's outgoing roommate, Marcus, to history professor Dr. Fairbanks, everyone has an opinion on the events unfolding at Briarwood College... and secrets they'd rather keep to themselves.

Put your detective skills to the test with a wide variety of puzzles and mini-games meant to twist the mind and assess your abilities. Decode hidden messages, examine evidence, uncover hidden compartments, and solve over 20 unique puzzles woven throughout the investigation.

Game Features:

  • First-Person Point-and-Click Gameplay

  • Fully Voice-Acted Cast

  • Over 20 Handcrafted Puzzles

  • Replayable Mini-Games

  • Choice-Driven Dialogue

  • Collect and Use Inventory Items

  • Beautiful Pre-Rendered 3D Environments

  • Journal, Task List, Evidence Folder & Hint System

  • Inspired by Classic Mystery Adventures like Nancy Drew and Myst

Journalism major Chandler Chase finds himself caught in a murder investigation he never asked to be part of. Interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, and unravel a conspiracy someone is desperate to keep hidden.
